content.text: {"headline":"Approve R1: front-loaded overtime with late moves gets the best predicted service level (72.9%) of any compliant plan, but still short of the 80% target","why":"The spike is extra demand from the MKT-2026-551 personal loan email, not a staffing gap. Over the last four intervals there were 307 calls against 236 forecast, mostly loan_enquiry and new_offer_enquiry, and service level fell to 68% at 09:45. No plan reaches 80%, so R1 was chosen as the best available option within policy. It offers overtime to 20 general agents 14:30-16:00 and 4 more 16:00-17:00, delays payments breaks 14:00-15:00 by 45 min, moves 8 cross-skilled agents from payments to general 16:00-18:00, and cancels general coaching 15:45-16:45. It also deflects 20% of new_offer_enquiry calls to chat and turns on IVR callback 14:00-17:00. Predicted results are 72.9% overall (general 68.1%, payments 78.1%) and abandons of 6.3%, down from 68.2% and 8.9% if we do nothing.","trade_offs":["Cost: INR 3,261 extra. The cheaper plans P1 (INR 825), P2 (INR 456), P3 (INR 2,361) and P4 (INR 2,265) all break policy BRK-04, which limits repeated break delays for the same agents. P1, P2 and P3 also break MOV-03, dropping payments to 50-62% during the 15:00-16:00 move.","R2 is also compliant and costs INR 3,471. It gives general slightly more (68.7%) but payments less (76.5%), with a lower overall level (72.5%) and higher abandons (6.6%).","Risk to payments: R1 keeps payments at 78.1% because its move to general starts only at 16:00.","Customer impact: general stays well below target at 68.1%, so waits will remain long even with this plan."],"watch":"R1 depends on agents taking up the overtime. If fewer than 20 accept for 14:30-16:00, general will fall further short. Also watch whether loan_enquiry and new_offer_enquiry volumes keep running above forecast, and check that chat deflection is actually absorbing new_offer_enquiry calls. Since even the best plan misses 80%, tell the duty manager about the expected shortfall, although no escalation is flagged."}
